{{Youmay|the covert operation|the [[Aphelion III|ship]]}}
'''Operation: Aphelion''' was a covert operation undertaken in the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Watcher X]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] on behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
